metadata.description: Curated subset of the RQ2 screen MAIN concept pool: per-concept yearly diffusion indicators (2000-2024) for 100 of the 202 screen MAIN concepts (both frozen medoids + proportional stratified sample of the two full-run clusters). Input to the 3-channel DTW + k-medoids diffusion typology (src/typology.py). full_run_* fields are the labels obtained on all 202 concepts.
